messages.content: 请只输出 Python 源码。不得使用 imports、class 定义或测试代码。

Return only Python source, with no imports, classes, tests or explanatory text. Implement run_spans(text) and expand_spans(spans). run_spans returns a list of (character,start,end) tuples for maximal consecutive runs of Unicode code points, using zero-based half-open offsets. Empty text returns []. expand_spans reconstructs the text. It raises ValueError for malformed input: every item must be a three-element list or tuple, character a one-character string, start/end integers excluding bool, start >= 0, end > start, first start 0, and each later start exactly the preceding end (no gaps or overlaps). Empty spans returns an empty string. Adjacent valid spans with the same character are allowed. Do not mutate inputs. Use Python builtins only; include useful docstrings and handle edge cases.

请按要求输出 Python 源码；不得输出说明文字、imports、class 定义或测试代码。
